module origen_163217 #(

) (

    input i_Reset_n,

    input i_Stall,

    input [ADDRESS_WIDTH-1:0] i_PC,
    input i_Value_Predicted,
    input [31:0] i_Instruction,
    input [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] i_ALU_Result,
    input i_Mem_Valid,

    input [CHECKPOINT_WIDTH-1:0] i_Checkpoint,

    output reg o_Value_Predicted,
    output reg [31:0] o_Instruction,

    always @(posedge i_Clk) begin

            o_Phys_Active_List_Index <= 0;
            o_Checkpoint <= 0;
            o_Is_Branch <= 0;
        end
        else if (!i_Stall) begin
            if (i_Flush) begin
                o_PC <= 0;
                o_Value_Predicted <= 0;
                o_Instruction <= 0;
                o_ALU_Result <= 0;
                o_Mem_Valid <= 0;
                o_Mem_Mask <= 0;
                o_Mem_Read_Write_n <= 0;

                o_Checkpoint <= 0;
                o_Is_Branch <= 0;
            end
            else begin
                o_PC <= i_PC;
                o_Value_Predicted <= i_Value_Predicted;
                o_Instruction <= i_Instruction;
                o_ALU_Result <= i_ALU_Result;
                o_Mem_Valid <= i_Mem_Valid;
                o_Mem_Mask <= i_Mem_Mask;

Runner-assembled entry point. This package does not retain an exact starting instruction file. The input/output and stage panels below describe the task; the evaluation runner’s saved prompt and visible-file manifest identify the actual entry point. A case manifest or private reference file is not an agent starting instruction.

A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs. The file list also includes human-review reference and oracle assets that must not be given to the evaluated agent.
